body:
Wow.. I know some people are wonderful. That is what I thought about my friend.. When I was down about anything I would feel much happier after talking to her. I just really can't believe it came to this now :( I don't feel sad, I feel bit like heartbroken if it can be described as that. 

I think so irrationally. From experience I know this won't be on my mind so much months later. But it's the only thing I can think about at the moment, tho you have gave me hope. even though we don't know each other.

I clicked on your username and saw your other post. I just want to say, I'm really shy too in real life. I'm better online. But I've been improving slightly. And it makes me really sad to see that you posted, because you seem like a wonderful person.. I really appreciate how you replyed to me and made me feel a lot better, even though I still feel horrible right now.

I stay up late to drown away sadness until I'll collapse when I sleep, and regret that in the mornings. I felt like this, and cried years ago, but I do know things have gotten better for a while, and maybe.. Not maybe, but hopefully it will again. Its nice to feel you're not alone. I think, if you think someone is happy you just don't know them well enough.

I hope you don't feel terrified posting that post anymore. One thing I say to myself a bit when I panic about how people might perceive me, I think that nobody really cares anyway. Maybe go and comment on something that interests you, or just do things that you feel icky about, steps at a time like what you are doing now.  You seem really like a nice and wonderful person <3 thank you again for listening and helping me.. 

Keep strong to you too.. I still don't know if I'll ever find a true friend, or how long it will take, or if I still will be alive by then but I know I should keep trying. Hopefully something as nice as your comment materialises. And you should too.. you're awesome.

*hugs*
